name: Maximum entropy spectral estimation (MESE)
definition_zh: 通过最大熵准则估计信号功率谱密度的方法。
definition_en: A spectral estimation method used here to estimate the power spectral density of measured track irregularities.
usage_overview: 用于从实测轨道不平顺记录及其分段序列中估计功率谱密度，为随机不平顺建模建立谱样本集合；也用于处理短样本功率谱估计中的泄漏问题。

complete_examples.text: To solve the issues on energy leakage of window function, especially for signals with small sampling length, the maximum entropy spectral estimation (MESE) [18] is applied to calculate the PSD of track irregularity.

The maximum entropy spectral estimation (MESE) [15] is applied to calculate the PSD of track irregularity, and the PSD function is recorded as ρv; pðωÞ, where N is the total number of PSD samples and v represents the type of irregularity (VP, AG, CL, and GE).
